messages.subject: Subscript out of range
parts:
Dear google group, 

I am trying to design a new survey with three strata which are approximately rectangular. I have made a new survey design but when I run it setting up a new survey each time I'm getting the error below. I have seen on other posts here that it might have something to do with the LinkID field but my Strata layer has the three LinkID rows included. My coverage layer was just made using the create 'create data layer' button. 

Any help would be greatly appreciated. 
Trisha
